lines: CASTLE BURIAL GROUND. LOWER CHAMBERS. Four corners off THE HALL, in the order they were dug: THE KEEPER OF HIS SNAKES, HIS GARDENER, HIS HOUSEKEEPER, HIS SOLDIER.

THE STAIR comes down into THE HALL, and THE VIGIL is off it. THE KEEPER OF HIS SNAKES lies past THE ALCOVE, THE RAT RUN and THE GUARD. HIS GARDENER lies past THE STATUE PASSAGE, his garden and THE ORCHARD, in his glasshouse. HIS HOUSEKEEPER lies past THE LINEN ROOM, and HIS SOLDIER past THE LONG ROOM.
GNOX GOLDSKIN lies behind the sealed door off THE HALL. The seal is turned when his four are still, and not before.
Interments by arrangement with the parish. The four corners were all arranged on the same morning.
GNOX GOLDSKIN. HE BOUGHT THIS GROUND AND EVERY ROW IN IT.
Cut smaller underneath, and later: somebody is still bringing the soldier flowers.
Somebody sat up with the dead here and kept a fire while they did it. It catches for you at once, and it is the only warm light down here.
Nothing comes near while it burns. If it goes badly out there, this is where you will wake.
The hearth burns as though it had been laid this morning. The dead trees stand back from it.
Nothing comes near while it burns. If it goes badly out there, this is where you will wake.
THE HALL. His four lie in the corners off it.
THE STAIR. Up to the Hoar Stone.
THE ALCOVE. On the way to THE KEEPER OF HIS SNAKES.
Cut smaller underneath: the torches in it are lit with cold.
THE RAT RUN. Between THE ALCOVE and THE GUARD.
THE GUARD. Between THE RAT RUN and THE KEEPER OF HIS SNAKES.
THE STATUE PASSAGE. Between THE HALL and the garden of HIS GARDENER.
Cut smaller underneath: HE FED THEM FROM HIS OWN PLATE. NOBODY ELSE WAS ALLOWED TO.
THE ORCHARD. Between the garden and the glasshouse of HIS GARDENER.
THE VIGIL. A fire is kept.
THE LINEN ROOM. Between THE HALL and HIS HOUSEKEEPER.
Cut smaller underneath: it has not been swept.
THE LONG ROOM. Between THE HALL and HIS SOLDIER.
Cut smaller underneath: it is opened by warm light, and by nothing else.
GNOX GOLDSKIN. Sealed.
The seal in THE HALL is turned when his four are still, and not before.
